snippet.title: SONIC FIGHTING HEROES: KING OF THE RING | SAGE 2025 TRAILER
snippet.description:
Here's the official trailer for Sonic Fighting Heroes: King of The Ring, the fanmade 2D Fighting Game! Do you have what it takes to return the Master Emerald to it's rightful resting place? LET'S FIND OUT!

Available NOW at SAGE 2025!
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-fighting-heroes-king-of-the-ring.2810/

MUSIC:
https://youtu.be/74JttD7wYO4?si=ZyDawyVaKp6bMPzR
(This is also the Neo Egg Hangar stage theme!)
